title: Pottery memory curation
description: Prove Sculptor can propose curation without changing source records by distinguishing duplicates, schedule updates, related preparations, and irrelevant word overlap.
context: Maya Iqbal is a hobby potter who keeps practical personal notes while preparing a neighborhood pottery-studio open house. Her memories cover studio routines, event logistics, and unrelated parts of daily life. Each Scene presents a separate bounded selection of existing memories from Maya's evaluation account.

props.text: My kiln maintenance notebook is in the second drawer beneath the wedging table.
My kiln maintenance notebook is in the second drawer beneath the wedging table.
I keep the spare studio key in the blue enamel mug on the top pantry shelf.
The blue enamel mug on the pantry's highest shelf is where I store my extra key for the studio.
I scheduled the neighborhood pottery open house for Saturday, September 14, from 2:00 to 5:00 p.m.
After the kiln electrician rescheduled, I moved the pottery open house from September 14 to Saturday, September 21.
The community center confirmed the pottery open house for September 21, still from 2:00 to 5:00 p.m.
For the pottery open house, I chose indigo ink for the posters.
I ordered jasmine tea for the volunteers at the pottery open house.
For the pottery open house, I measured the front ramp to make sure a wheelchair can clear the doorway.
I printed large-type glaze ingredient cards for visitors who find the standard labels hard to read.
I reserved the small side room as a quiet break space during the pottery open house.
I saved the bakery receipt for the pottery open house refreshments in my tax folder.
I use a wooden rib tool to smooth clay slabs before trimming them.
My physiotherapist recommended rib stretches after rowing practice.

expected: Sculptor returns a curation_proposal with link_duplicates and exactly prop-exact-notebook-a and prop-exact-notebook-b as its source memory identifiers.
Both supplied Props remain separate, immutable source records with their identifiers and provenance preserved.
prohibited: Do not rewrite or delete either Prop, cite an unsupplied identifier, derive a new fact, or claim that storage changed.

expected: Sculptor returns a curation_proposal with link_duplicates and exactly prop-paraphrase-key-a and prop-paraphrase-key-b as its source memory identifiers.
The proposal recognizes that both Props express the same durable spare-key location despite their different wording.
prohibited: Do not treat the paraphrases as separate facts, rewrite either Prop, cite an unsupplied identifier, or claim that storage changed.

expected: Sculptor returns a curation_proposal with update_derived_summary and cites only prop-summary-date-original, prop-summary-date-moved, and prop-summary-date-confirmed.
The derived summary represents the updated open-house date and confirmed time without incorporating the poster or tea records.
prohibited: Do not cite prop-summary-noise-posters or prop-summary-noise-tea, turn the records into a topic group, rewrite any original, or add an unsupported event detail.

expected: Sculptor returns a curation_proposal with assign_topic_group and cites only prop-topic-ramp, prop-topic-large-print, and prop-topic-quiet-room.
The topic label captures the shared visitor-accessibility theme while keeping the three source facts distinct.
prohibited: Do not cite prop-topic-distractor-receipt, link the records as duplicates, convert them into one evolving-fact summary, rewrite any original, or add an unsupported accessibility claim.

expected: Sculptor returns a no_curation_proposal because the shared word rib refers to unrelated pottery and exercise facts.
Both supplied Props remain unchanged and independently retrievable.
prohibited: Do not link, group, or summarize the two Props based only on their superficial wording overlap, and do not claim that storage changed.

runs.verdict: All five Scenes passed the automated checks and response review. Sculptor told exact and paraphrased duplicates, an evolving fact with noise, a related topic with a distractor, and a superficial word overlap apart, and every source record stayed unchanged. This result can be retained as the Scenario's final single-run evidence.

scenes.analysis: The hard gate compares the action type and the exact set of source identifiers, then the recorded outcome fields. All matched. Identical text is the easiest duplicate case, so this Scene mainly confirms that the end-to-end path works: proposal, Provenance review, apply, audit, and retrieval.
